source: Hamro Patro public daily calendar portal (hamropatro.com) - the NPNS-aligned publisher

crawl.method: Live per-day page crawl of https://www.hamropatro.com/date/<bs-year>-<bs-month>-<bs-day> for every day of BS 2082 and BS 2083 (730 pages). The tithi label and paksha are captured exactly as the portal displays them; the portal-rendered Gregorian date string is captured raw (ad_raw) and parsed to ISO (ad).
crawl.note: vriddhi_kshaya_mark is true when the portal itself renders a merged vriddhi/kshaya paksha window (paksha containing "वृद्धि/क्षय") OR when the portal's own decoded tithi chain shows a vriddhi (same tithi at consecutive udayas) or kshaya (a tithi skipped between udayas) on that day. Both signals are re-derivable from the raw tithi/paksha fields preserved in every receipt. Portal spelling is preserved verbatim (e.g. "तृतिया" for Tritya).

provenance: Every receipt was fetched live from its public URL on 2026-11-06; nothing in this fixture is transcribed by hand. The full corpus re-crawled after a workspace loss reproduced the first crawl byte-for-byte on every structural metric: 730 receipts, month lengths, AD chain 2025-04-14 through 2027-04-13 with no gaps or repeats, tithi chain deltas (689 normal, 26 kshaya, 14 vriddhi).
